en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a city square with a prominent statue of Otto von Bismarck on a pedestal marked "BISMARCK". The statue stands in a fenced-off area with steps and railings in the foreground. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings with shops on the ground floor, and in the background a tall church spire rises above the roofs. German captions are printed at the top indicating the location and the monument.
